title: A part's core turns untracked together with the part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CORETRK-01, described {Description-A}, for example ZZAUTOTEST PL CORE TRACKING) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A} and a Core Charge of $25.00, so it has a core.
  • The core of {Part-A} is described "Core for {Description-A}"; it is {Core-A}.
  • The new global search (Search in the top bar) is on, as it is by default for every account.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} in Inventory and click its row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is off.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click Search in the top bar and type Core for {Description-A}.
  5. Read the {Core-A} result.
  6. Press Esc, then click the {Part-A} row again.
  7. Click the switch so it is on.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Search Core for {Description-A} in the top bar again and read the {Core-A} result.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: {Part-A} reads "Not Tracked" in Total Qty, and its Core column still reads $25.00.
  • Steps 4 and 9: If global search lists no "Core for {Description-A}" result, the core's tracking cannot be seen on any screen: this part cannot be checked by hand; write "not checked by hand" in the result comment.
  • Step 5: The {Core-A} result shows "Not Tracked" in place of its available badge: it changed with the same save as {Part-A}, and you did not edit the core.
  • Step 9: The {Core-A} result shows an available badge again (a number, not "Not Tracked"), changed by the same save that turned {Part-A} back on.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S5-R9, S9-R20 (how global search shows an untracked part) and §4 Key Decisions (A core follows its part), read 14 Oct 2026. Design: no board shows a core. Where cores show: QA lead's answer of 9 Oct 2026, situation 5. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R9: “The part's core is tracked or untracked together with the part, in the same save. A core added to the part later, or in the same save, takes the part's tracking state.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions: “A core follows its part. A core is never activated, deactivated, tracked or untracked on its own.”
  • S9-R20: “Global search shows "Not Tracked" for an untracked part, in place of its "{n} available" badge.”
